v1.beleg_sql:
WITH vorher AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vvh_id) vvh_id, oenace FROM bereinigt.abschnitt WHERE lieferung = '2024-12' AND regelsatz = 'v1' AND beginn <= DATE '2024-12-31' AND (ende IS NULL OR ende >= DATE '2024-12-31') ORDER BY vvh_id, beginn DESC),
     nachher AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vvh_id) vvh_id, oenace FROM bereinigt.abschnitt WHERE lieferung = '2025-01' AND regelsatz = 'v1' AND beginn <= DATE '2024-12-31' AND (ende IS NULL OR ende >= DATE '2024-12-31') ORDER BY vvh_id, beginn DESC)
SELECT v.oenace AS alt, n.oenace AS neu, count(*) AS verhaeltnisse
FROM vorher v JOIN nachher n USING (vvh_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
